source.check: returned unopposed: named in the Impartial Reporter's nominations report of 21 May 1964 (p. 7) among 'the 22 other seats [that] remain unchanged'; there was no contest for Enniskillen Rural Council

note: Triennial election of Enniskillen Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There was no contest, but four changes in personnel were reported: Ivan Loane replaced Richard Thornton at a Unionist delegates' meeting for Lisbofin, John James Nixon replaced Thomas Bothwell for Coolyermore, John R. Leonard filled the vacant Holywell seat, and the sitting Kinglass member, Mr. Mathew McHugh, was not nominated. The Impartial Reporter of 21 May 1964, p. 7, reports the full nominations: Mr. Richard Thornton (Unionist), passed over for Lisbofin, 'takes the place of Mr. Matthew McHugh for the Kinglass division', and names the members for 'the 22 other seats [which] remain unchanged'. All twenty-six divisions are filled from that report (6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
